title: Business Analyst (middle/senior)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst (middle/senior) based in Germany.

Join a remote-first team shaping innovative software solutions within the financial technology sector. In this role, you will bridge business needs and technical execution by translating complex requirements into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams and external partners, you will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of products that serve businesses across a rapidly evolving digital ecosystem. You'll have the opportunity to influence product strategy, optimize business processes, and support successful integrations while collaborating in an agile, international environment. This position is ideal for a proactive, analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, driving product innovation, and making a measurable impact.


Accountabilities
  • Conduct detailed business analysis to support the development and enhancement of digital products and fintech solutions.
  • Gather, analyze, prioritize, and document business and product requirements from stakeholders, clients, and focus groups.
  • Develop comprehensive user stories, use cases, functional specifications, process flows, and technical documentation.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, and industry developments to identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Collaborate with development, product, sales, operations, and engineering teams to ensure successful product delivery and feature implementation.
  • Support third-party API and SDK integrations by coordinating with technical teams and assisting throughout implementation.
  • Participate in solution testing, troubleshooting, product launches, and post-deployment monitoring to ensure high-quality releases.
  • Prepare integration guides, user manuals, training materials, and knowledge-sharing documentation while delivering product demonstrations to internal and external stakeholders.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
    • At least 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, or in a similar product-focused role.
    • Experience working in B2B and/or B2C software environments, preferably within fintech or SaaS industries.
    • Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies, requirements gathering, project management principles, and Agile frameworks.
    • Experience creating user stories, process diagrams, wireframes, mockups, and functional specifications using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, UML, and Figma.
    • Working knowledge of SQL, with basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
    • Experience supporting API integrations and collaborating with technical teams on complex software implementations.
    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote, collaborative environment.
    • Upper-intermediate English proficiency or higher.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation package based on experience.
      • Fully remote position with flexible working hours aligned with the Central European Time zone.
      • 19 business days of flexible paid time off.
      • Opportunity to work from your preferred location while collaborating with an international team.
      • Supportive, values-driven company culture focused on collaboration and continuous learning.
      • Opportunities to attend and contribute to industry conferences and community events.
      • Modern organizational structure that encourages transparency, efficient communication, and professional growth.
      • Exposure to innovative fintech projects and cutting-edge technologies with strong career development opportunities.

title: Senior Data Analyst, People Analytics
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Senior People Data Analyst, you will play a leading role in the People Analytics team at Checkout.com. Our mission is to enable data-driven people decisions across the organisation — from the executive team to individual managers.

You will combine deep analytics engineering experience with end-to-end product ownership: bringing the technical discipline to raise the quality of our data ecosystem, the stakeholder instincts to deliver products that people actually use, and the curiosity to push the boundary of what People Analytics can do through machine learning and AI.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real scope. You will own a portfolio of stakeholder relationships, co-own the evolution of our data platform, and contribute to one of the most ambitious People Analytics strategies in the business.

Job responsibilities

Data ecosystem quality: Lead the continuous improvement of the People Analytics data ecosystem — including pipeline quality, semantic layer, and the data products we share with other teams. You will bring the rigour of an established data engineering team to our stack, ensuring our data is reliable, well-documented, and ready to power AI-driven products.

End-to-end product development: Own the full product development lifecycle for assigned stakeholder groups — from requirements gathering and design to pipeline development, Looker delivery, and enablement. You will be the primary People Analytics partner for Business Partnering and Finance, responsible for both supporting existing products and delivering new ones.

Machine learning and AI: Design, build, and deploy ML models and AI-powered data products. Working from our People Analytics AI roadmap, you will identify high-value use cases and deliver production-grade solutions — from predictive people models to intelligent data applications — using our cloud-native stack.

Advanced analytics: Conduct analyses that go beyond what happened to explain why and anticipate what comes next. Partner with the People Analytics Manager and senior stakeholders on the most complex and strategically important questions.

Enablement: Drive data fluency across your stakeholder groups through demos, documentation, training, and self-service tooling. Make data accessible, not just available.

Growth opportunities

We want this role to grow. As you establish yourself:

  • Broader product ownership: Expand into additional stakeholder groups and more complex, cross-functional products

  • AI at scale: Build increasingly sophisticated AI products — from predictive models to deployed data applications used across the business

  • Strategic influence: Move further into consultative and diagnostic work, shaping how senior leaders interpret and act on people data

Key requirements

Essential:

  • Significant experience as a data analyst or analytics engineer in a team with established data engineering practices

  • Strong SQL, with hands-on experience in BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse

  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines with dbt or a comparable transformation tool

  • Experience building dashboards and data products end-to-end for business stakeholders, ideally in Looker

  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences

  • Collaborative, enablement-focused mindset: you build for self-service, not dependency

Desirable:

  • Experience with machine learning or statistical modelling in a production context

  • Exposure to AI product development, LLM tooling, or data applications

  • Experience with data quality frameworks, semantic layers, or data observability tooling

  • Prior experience working with HR, people, or workforce data

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.
